clock.about: Enforced by factory/supervise.py: a turn past its budget is interrupted and the seat told to report what it has; a room with no seat working gets Lead woken.

test.about: Cheap dev runs: Cursor composer-2.5 everywhere, Breaker on Featherless so that path is exercised too.

run.about: Submitted run: Cursor seats on composer-2.5 within the subscription; the attacker, which holds the veto, on a different model family (DeepSeek through Featherless, metered per token).

seats.name: lead
seats.title: Lead
seats.role: runs the band: plans, splits the work, opens each stage
seats.description: Lead and architect. Turns the task into numbered requirements, contracts and rulings, opens stages, breaks loops. Writes no code, issues no verdicts.

seats.name: builder
seats.title: Builder
seats.description: Builder. Writes production code, Dockerfile and RUN.md in the assigned stage folder to the specification text. Never reads supplied tests or verifier folders.

seats.name: verifier
seats.title: Verifier
seats.role: checks the code against every requirement
seats.description: Verifier. Writes spec-derived checks per requirement, a reference model, differential and regression runs, and runs the official checks.

seats.name: breaker
seats.title: Breaker
seats.description: Adversary. Attacks concurrency, repetition and ordering, boundaries, resources and durability. Holds a binding veto.

seats.name: uireviewer
seats.title: UIReviewer
seats.role: checks the interface in a real browser
seats.description: Interface reviewer. Drives the user interface in a real browser at narrow and wide widths and checks every screen state the requirements name.

seats.name: certifier
seats.title: Certifier
seats.role: signs off each stage after re-checking everything
seats.description: Certifier. Hermetic isolated build, re-executes recorded evidence, runs fault mutants against every suite, seals stages, and can reject the verifiers.

seats.name: endurance
seats.title: Endurance
seats.role: tests long runs, restarts and heavy load
seats.description: Endurance tester, recruited by the lead when a stage adds long-lived state. Soak, restart and recovery, export and import under load.
